InstitutionFacility

class InstitutionFacility(id, name, address, phone, email, website, social_network, type)[source]

Bases: object

Health institution / facility entity.

Represents a service location with contact information.

Attributes:
idint

Unique identifier for the facility.

namestr

Facility name.

addressstr

Physical address.

phonestr

Contact phone number.

emailstr

Contact email address.

websitestr

Website URL.

social_networkstr

Social network or messaging endpoint.

typeint

Facility type code, a key of TYPE_MAP.

TYPE_MAPdict[int, str], class attribute

Facility type codes (0 to 7) to pt_BR type names; 0 is the empty “no type” entry.

PROPERTIESlist[str], class attribute

Field names, filled by initialize_reflexive.

DATA_PROPERTIESlist, class attribute

Field defaults, filled by initialize_reflexive.

Methods

is_valid() -> bool

Validate required fields.

set_data(data: dict) -> None

Populate fields from a dict.

get_data() -> list[dict]

Export fields as a list containing one dict.

Notes

The TYPE_MAP names are marked with QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP in the "InstitutionFacility" context: this only registers the pt_BR source texts for pyside6-lupdate. They are translated at display time with QCoreApplication.translate in that context, so a language change takes effect immediately.

Methods

get_data

Return the field values as a one-item list.

is_valid

Validate the facility object.

set_data

Update the fields from a dictionary.
is_valid()[source]

Validate the facility object.

Returns:
bool

True if the object is valid, False otherwise.

Notes

id must be an int, name must not be blank and type must be an int key of TYPE_MAP; the other fields may be empty but not None.

Examples

>>> inst = InstitutionFacility(1, 'A', '', '', '', '', '', 0)
>>> inst.is_valid()
True
>>> inst = InstitutionFacility(None, '', '', '', '', '', '', 0)
>>> inst.is_valid()
False
set_data(data)[source]

Update the fields from a dictionary.

Parameters:
datadict

Values keyed by field name. Keys that are not fields are ignored, and fields missing from data keep their value.

Notes

No validation or type conversion is done.

Examples

>>> inst = InstitutionFacility(1, 'A', '', '', '', '', '', 0)
>>> inst.set_data({'name': 'B', 'type': 1})
>>> inst.name
'B'
get_data()[source]

Return the field values as a one-item list.

Returns:
list[dict]

A list with one dictionary that maps each name of PROPERTIES to its current value.

Examples

>>> inst = InstitutionFacility(1, 'A', '', '', '', '', '', 0)
>>> inst.get_data()[0]['name']
'A'
